meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 用户要求重构代码时，Claude 会先确认需求，再分析相关代码和依赖关系，评估测试覆盖情况，然后制定逐步计划并执行。每改一步都会运行测试确认没弄坏东西；测试覆盖不足时会先提示风险。最后跑完整检查和测试，并汇报改动。
howto.when: 当用户提到“refactor”、“cleanup”、“extract”等触发词，或直接使用 /refactor 命令时，该技能会启动。需求模糊时它会先提问澄清。

say.text: 请重构 src/auth/handler.ts，拆出验证逻辑。
say.note: 会先确认目标、分析依赖，再动手。

say.text: 把旧 API 调用统一替换成新 API。
say.note: 会先找出所有相关代码和测试。

say.text: 用 /refactor --scope=project 清理项目重复代码。
say.note: 会评估测试覆盖并制定计划。

howto.what_en: On refactor requests, Claude clarifies intent, maps code, checks test coverage, plans, then executes incrementally—verifying tests after each step, then runs full tests and type checks. It reports changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords such as refactor, cleanup, extract, etc., or the /refactor command. Vague requests prompt clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Please refactor src/auth/handler.ts and extract the validation logic.
say_en.note: It analyzes the file and dependencies first.

say_en.text: Replace all old API calls with the new API everywhere.
say_en.note: It finds all related code and tests first.

say_en.text: Use /refactor --scope=project to clean up duplicate code.
say_en.note: It assesses coverage, plans, then executes step by step.
